flex-layout.about: The Yoga subset: direction, justify, align, gap, padding, grow, wrap.

states-tokens.about: Token resolution per node, the state merge order, autofocus and inherited opacity.

bindings.about: Bound text, bound visibility and a bound Toggle, fed through the data channel.

text-wrap.about: The normative wrap algorithm: break points, hard breaks, long words, maxLines, ellipsis, alignment and line height.

scroll-clip.about: Scrollable extents on both axes, what a scrollable axis offers to a wrap, and clipped subtrees.

collapse-tabs.about: display:none semantics through a Collapse and an exclusive-select group.

controls.about: Toggle slots, a radio group by value, both Slider axes with quantization, a bound ProgressBar and the Spinner wave.

textinput.about: Field geometry, the placeholder's empty state, a bound value and content that overflows its box.

transitions.about: Tweened values at REST — the clock is run to the end of the longest duration, so this records where the motion settles.

assets-image.about: Intrinsic size from the manifest and the three fit modes. Pixels are never decoded: layout does not need them.

repeat.about: A bound array expanded into instances, virtualized inside a scroller, plus the empty-state slot of an absent array.

anchors.about: Every AnchorAt placement with room around it, the flip at each viewport edge, the slide that keeps a wide bubble on screen, and an anchor below a ScrollView's fold whose overlay leaves the layer.

overlays.about: The layer in (z, document order), a modal taking the focus with it, and a hover-triggered tooltip that is absent until its anchor lights up.

settings.about: The whole F5 catalog composed as one screen: the selected tab's panel in the layout and the other out of it, a select whose anchored popover stays closed, and a toggle, a slider and a field all reading their value from the data.
